Ruijie RG-EW1200G PRO 1300Mbps Gigabit Dual-Band Mesh WiFi 5 Router


Get fast, stable, and wide-range internet coverage with the Ruijie RG-EW1200G PRO, a high-performance Dual-Band Mesh WiFi 5 router designed for modern homes and offices in Bangladesh. With speeds up to 1300Mbps and gigabit Ethernet ports, this router ensures smooth streaming, online gaming, and multiple device connections without interruptions. Its mesh networking capability allows seamless coverage across large areas, eliminating dead zones and ensuring a strong signal everywhere.

Key Specifications:

  • Wi-Fi Standard: IEEE 802.11ac (WiFi 5), backward compatible with 802.11a/b/g/n
  • Dual-Band Speed: Up to 1300Mbps combined (867Mbps @ 5GHz + 400Mbps @ 2.4GHz)
  • Mesh Networking: Supports Ruijie Mesh for extended and seamless WiFi coverage
  • Ethernet Ports: 3 × Gigabit LAN ports + 1 × Gigabit WAN port
  • Antenna: 4 × high-gain external antennas for wider coverage
  • Processor: High-performance CPU for stable multi-device connections
  • Security: WPA/WPA2 encryption, firewall protection
  • Features: MU-MIMO, Beamforming+, IPv6 support, easy mobile app management
  • Coverage: Ideal for medium to large homes and offices
  • Design: Sleek and modern design with space-saving footprint
